verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the docs index entry "Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID". It points to a first-party provisioning capability for an enterprise directory, which bears on pre-registration, but only the title is shown and nothing about scale or depth. The nitropy CLI is a general device tool and counts only as a developer building block for scripting bulk setup, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk/mass configuration workflows, detail on how Entra ID pre-registration works at scale, lifecycle tracking or inventory of issued keys (assignment, revocation, retirement), and independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet provisioning.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys
